title: The Sleeping Cellar
author: Petra Eastwick
blurb: Ada Dunmore, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
